subject.title: [Bug]: exec spawn UNKNOWN after gateway restart — child_process pool not rebuilt

question: Should this stay open as a live Windows repro request, or should maintainers split a narrower Windows `spawn UNKNOWN` hardening task now?
rationale: Source inspection proves the reported pool-rebuild root cause is wrong and that `UNKNOWN` would propagate, but it does not prove gateway restart causes the OS-level error on current main.

options.title: Keep as live repro request
options.body: Wait for a current-main Windows log, recording, or Crabbox/manual transcript before queueing repair so the fix targets the real failure layer.

options.title: Split spawn hardening task
options.body: Create a narrower maintainer-owned issue for retrying proven transient Windows `UNKNOWN` spawn errors without claiming the restart trigger is reproduced.

options.title: Close after no repro window
options.body: Close later under stale/insufficient-info policy if no current-main Windows evidence arrives after the age threshold is met.

recommendation.title: Keep as live repro request
recommendation.body: Wait for a current-main Windows log, recording, or Crabbox/manual transcript before queueing repair so the fix targets the real failure layer.
